matrix.test: Paired T- and G-allele reporter assay in HCT 116, comparing control cells with TFAP2E-depleted cells.

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible TFAP2E-dependent difference between the T and G constructs.
A T-versus-G reporter difference that is reduced by TFAP2E depletion; the direction of reporter activity is not specified by the binding prediction.
No TFAP2E-dependent allelic difference; an EBF4-dependent effect is possible but is not tested by this perturbation.
No TFAP2E-dependent allelic difference; an ETV3-dependent effect is possible but is not tested by this perturbation.

matrix.test: Measure allele-resolved TFAP2E, EBF4, and ETV3 occupancy at the endogenous locus in an informative HCT 116 model, using targeted CUT&RUN or equivalent.

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible TF occupancy difference between alleles.
TFAP2E occupancy is detected and favors T over G.
EBF4 occupancy is detected and favors T over G.
ETV3 occupancy is detected and favors G over T.

matrix.test: Create isogenic T- and G-allele HCT 116 cells and measure expression of PYDC2 and other nearby genes, with and without TFAP2E perturbation.

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible allele-dependent, TFAP2E-dependent expression change.
An allele-dependent expression change that is reduced by TFAP2E perturbation; the direction and target gene remain to be determined.
No TFAP2E-dependent change predicted; an EBF4-dependent change remains possible.
No TFAP2E-dependent change predicted; an ETV3-dependent change remains possible.

next_experiment: The lowest-cost test that separates the top two hypotheses (H0 and H1) is a paired T/G reporter assay in HCT 116 with and without TFAP2E depletion. A TFAP2E-dependent allelic difference would support H1, although a reporter result would not by itself establish endogenous target-gene or colorectal-cancer effects.
